descriptionChirho: To actively prevent, restrain, or withhold someone or something from proceeding or being given (Qal active sense).
To physically enclose or imprison a person, shutting them in a confined space (Qal active and passive participle with focus on physical confinement).
To be held back or stopped, describing the passive cessation of rain, plague, or other forces (Nifal stem).
To bring something to completion or termination, an intensive or causative nuance of restraining to the point of ending (Piel stem).
